column3: Close to the Hebrew.
“In their ears” is rendered “in their hearing,” and “scroll” as “book.”
NASB supplies “his” with “heart” and “soul”; “establish” is rendered “carry out.”
“Articles” is rendered “vessels,” and “dust” as “ashes.”
“Pagan priests” is rendered “idolatrous priests.” The Hebrew reads “and he made smoke”; NASB renders “to burn incense,” relating it to the priests.
“Asherah pole” is rendered “the Asherah,” “wadi” as “brook,” and “burial site of the sons of the people” as “graves of the common people.”
“Containers” (Hebrew בָּתִּים, literally “houses”) is rendered “hangings”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Made smoke” is rendered “burned incense.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“The valley of Ben-hinnom” is rendered “the valley of the son of Hinnom.”
“Dedicated” is rendered “given,” and “the Parbar” as “the precincts”; the meaning is uncertain.
“He ran from there” is rendered “he smashed them there”; the Hebrew is difficult.
“On the face of Jerusalem” is rendered “before Jerusalem,” and “south” as “right.” “Astarte” is spelled “Ashtoreth,” and “detestable thing” as “abomination.”
“Asherah poles” is rendered “Asherim.”
NASB supplies “demolished its stones”; the Hebrew reads “he burned the high place.”
NASB supplies “Now when.”
“Monument” is kept; NASB supplies “It is.”
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB supplies “the LORD” as the one provoked.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Observe” is rendered “Celebrate,” and “scroll” as “book.”
NASB adds “Surely.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Necromancers and soothsayers” is rendered “mediums and spiritists,” and “carry out” as “confirm.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Burning of His anger” is rendered “fierceness of His great wrath.”
“From My face” is rendered “from My sight,” and “house” as “temple.”
Close to the Hebrew.
NASB names “Pharaoh Neco” as the one who saw and killed; “on the king of Assyria” is rendered “to the king of Assyria.”
“Made him ride dead” is rendered “drove his body in a chariot,” and “grave” as “tomb.”
